errors.profile_in_use: profile is bound to one or more agents — re-bind them first
errors.default_profile_in_use: the default credential's profile is bound to agents — re-bind them first
errors.default_engine_locked: this profile is the default for {engine} — make another profile the default before changing its engine
errors.engine_not_supported: agent does not support engine {engine}; supported: {supported} — declare it in thulu.engines.supported or send X-Force-Engine: true as admin
errors.clear_key_cloud_only: clear_key applies only to bedrock and vertex profiles
errors.key_required_for_provider: key required when switching the profile to {provider}
errors.cloud_profile_needs_credential: a {provider} profile needs a credential: this install does not let profiles use its own cloud identity (the operator can allow it with {env}=1)
errors.provider_not_supported: engine {engine} cannot use provider {provider:%q}; it supports: {supported}
errors.auth_header_not_for_provider: auth_header does not apply to {provider} profiles
errors.auth_header_fixed: {engine} always sends its key the same way; auth_header does not apply
errors.auth_header_needs_base_url: auth_header only applies to a profile with a base_url
errors.base_url_required: a {provider} profile needs a base_url: the server has no default address
errors.cloud_fields_cloud_only: region, project_id and small_fast_model apply only to bedrock and vertex profiles
errors.org_id_not_for_provider: org_id does not apply to {provider} profiles
errors.cloud_credentials_cloud_only: aws_* and gcp_* credentials apply only to bedrock and vertex profiles
errors.gcp_json_vertex_only: gcp_service_account_json applies only to vertex profiles
errors.bedrock_key_or_pair: send either an access key pair or a Bedrock API key (key), not both
errors.vertex_takes_gcp_json: vertex profiles take gcp_service_account_json, not a key or aws_* credentials
errors.gcp_json_not_service_account: gcp_service_account_json must be a service account key file (type service_account, with client_email and private_key)
errors.base_url_not_absolute: base_url must be an absolute URL
errors.base_url_has_credentials: base_url must not carry credentials; put the key in the profile
errors.base_url_http_not_allowed: base_url must use https:// — plain http is allowed only for localhost and hosts listed in OCTOPUS_LLM_ALLOW_HTTP_HOSTS
errors.kind_needs_kube_opt_in: a {kind} cannot be stored while agents run in Kubernetes: a shared cluster would run other people's work on one person's subscription. The operator can allow it for the installation owner with {env}=1
errors.owner_only_kind: only the installation owner (role owner in the workspace {env} names) can store a {kind}: it is a personal subscription, kept for testing
errors.owner_only_profile: only the installation owner (role owner in the workspace {env} names) can change a profile that holds a {kind}; send a new key to replace it
errors.owner_only_rotate: only the installation owner (role owner in the workspace {env} names) can rotate the workload identity signing key
errors.federation_not_supported: {engine} cannot authenticate by workload identity federation
errors.federation_own_provider: a federation profile talks to the engine's own API: no base_url, auth_header, cloud provider or cloud fields
errors.federation_no_key: a federation profile takes no key: the run gets an identity token instead
errors.federation_required: credential kind {kind:%q} needs the federation settings (federation_rule_id, organization_id, service_account_id)

hints.engine_no_longer_declared: agent no longer declares {engine} in thulu.engines.supported

log.key_check_failed: check the key of profile {profile} against {host}
log.key_check_store_failed: store the key check of profile {profile}
log.key_check_read_failed: read the key of profile {profile} to check it
log.refusal_store_failed: store the provider's refusal on profile {profile}
